_comment: Soldiers 5d sweep seed 9100047: Vial-put vs hand-cast ORDER. Vial on 2, two Plains, hand Champion of the Parish + Esper Sentinel + Cathar Commando (MV2 -- the only Vial-able card). Cast Champion, cast Sentinel, THEN Vial-put Commando: Champion takes +2 (3/3) and the T4 attack is 3+1+3 = 7 = lethal. Puts-first (Commando, Champion, Sentinel) gives +1 -> 6, no T4 kill. Inexpressible before the measured VialOrderChangesOutcome gate (the param list never named Champion).
